fields.statement: Built ./cmd/rhiza to a scratch bin put first on PATH, in a fresh git repo with a fake head (logs argv and cwd, prints a given report). rhiza check with SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA=fake execed 'check --json' in the repo root (also from a subdir) and printed its ok report, exit 0; --base/--skip-reference/--branch-newer-format passed through; rhiza check --json and api call check gave identical bytes; a fail report with child exit 1 printed the fail finding, exit 1; garbage output, a missing head with SHIP_HEAD_BUILD empty, and a failing build each errored naming SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA/the head build, exit 1; a missing head with SHIP_HEAD_BUILD set was built then run. In-process with no exec: env unset, SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA naming the PATH binary, and the same build run by a path off PATH (even with a failing SHIP_HEAD_BUILD); a symlinked PATH rhiza still used the head. go test ./internal/api -run 'TestCheckHeadBuild|TestLandRenderHeadBuild|TestShipHeadBuildOnDemand|TestShipPrePushCheck' and TestScripts/ship-gate-head-check pass; make self-check and SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA=$TMPDIR/no-head-rhiza SHIP_HEAD_BUILD= make self-check both pass from a clean detached checkout of HEAD. Only finding: the missing/failed-head error tail mentions land/render/push (minor).
